name: Hunting - SharePoint Web Shells and Rare w3wp.exe Children (2026 SharePoint KEV cluster)
description: Proactive 30-day hunt supporting the SharePoint exploitation detection for CVE-2026-45659, CVE-2026-56164, CVE-2026-58644, CVE-2026-50522 and CVE-2026-65660. Covers: (1) every ASPX/ASHX/ASMX file created or modified under SharePoint TEMPLATE folders, with the writing process and hash for comparison against known solution packages; (2) a stack-rank of rare child processes of SharePoint w3wp.exe across all SharePoint servers. Use it to find web shells planted before the detection rule was deployed.
